text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The combination of prolonged fever, severe bone pain, easy bruising, and now confirmed petechiae on physical exam strongly suggests a bone marrow infiltrative process like ALL. The pending bone marrow biopsy results will confirm the presence of blasts, but the clinical picture is already highly characteristic of this diagnosis.
